verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo so only a thin, unreadable sliver of the woman's face shows at the right edge, which loses the key image, and both shrink the blue panel's small text (Online Workshop, FREE JOIN) to near-illegible sizes. A sits the panel a little above centre, leaving a reasonable strip of foliage below it. B pushes its panel down until it almost touches the bottom edge, which leaves dead foliage above and a cramped bottom margin.
